_fixture: RETURNS_AUTH_* (VCST-5883, returns step 2 — agent approve/decline per line) — ONE Swagger-shaped create-body TEMPLATE for POST /api/order/customerOrders, shared by every return-decision fixture. The spec table RETURN_DECISION_FIXTURES in scripts/seed-data/orders/return-decisions-specs.mjs decides, per fixture, the order number, the order languageCode, which lines exist (lineY is dropped for a single-line fixture), their quantities and measure units, and the returns the buyer submits against it.
_why: Eight fixtures differ ONLY in the values the spec table stamps in, so one template keeps them from drifting apart in everything else (addresses, payment, currency, prices). A per-fixture JSON would be eight hand-maintained mirrors of the same body.
_contract: Every _-prefixed key is FIXTURE METADATA, stripped before the POST. No literal date (delivery dates come from the spec offsets at seed time), no runtime GUID (order/line/return ids land in test-data/aliases.<env>.json), no env-specific SKU (lines are live-discovered catalog products stamped in by role).
_seedPhases: PHASE 1 POST creates the order (the platform ASSIGNS line item ids and IGNORES client-supplied ones, so shipment items cannot be linked at create). PHASE 2 PUT stamps shipments[].items[] with the assigned lineItemId + the inline lineItem object (without the inline object the platform silently drops the shipment item) and the shipment deliveryDate. Line order is NOT preserved by the platform, so lines are matched by SKU, never by index.

items._note: Line A. Quantity + measureUnit come from the spec row; product identity is live-discovered.
items.name: AGENT-TEST Return Decision Line A

items._note: Line B — dropped by the builder when the spec row has no lineY. A DIFFERENT product from line A.
items.name: AGENT-TEST Return Decision Line B

shipments._note: ONE shipment delivering every line today; deliveredByRole comes from the spec row. number/trackingNumber are re-derived from the order number by the builder.
